operations.scientific_task: Upscale a D8 drainage network using iterative hydrography-preserving IHU.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing D8 accumulation/delineation/Strahler tools retain grid resolution; IHU constructs a topologically consistent coarser network.
operations.numeric_oracle: Synthetic 4x4 all-east-then-south network, scale 2: coarse east-then-south topology [[1,4],[1,0]], cell side 2 m; final outlet source index 15. Check routing to one terminal independently of upstream outlet choices.

operations.scientific_task: Calculate subcatchment flood storage-volume curves from prescribed HAND and stages.
operations.distinct_from_existing: HAND terrain metric and catchment delineation do not provide a stage-dependent storage-volume relation; no hydrodynamic inundation claim.
operations.numeric_oracle: Synthetic cells with areas 4 m2 and HAND [3,1,0] draining to index 2: stages [1,2,4] give [4,12,32] m3 by sum(area*max(stage-HAND,0)).

operations.scientific_task: Simplify internal boundaries of an edge-matched polygon coverage without simplifying its outer boundary.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Generic GeoShapelyGeometry per-feature simplify can break coverage topology; this calls the coverage-aware algorithm with boundary preservation.
operations.numeric_oracle: Two adjacent unit squares stay a gap-free partition with total area 2 m2 and unchanged outer boundary; shared edge coordinates agree in both polygons.

operations.scientific_task: Transfer extensive totals between complete polygon partitions by intersection-area allocation.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Exact raster zonal statistics aggregates samples under polygons; this conservatively redistributes polygon extensive quantities between nonmatching partitions.
operations.numeric_oracle: Totals 100 and 200 kg on two equal-area source rectangles, each bisected: target totals [50,50,100,100], global mass 300 kg.

operations.scientific_task: Aggregate cell-by-cell MODFLOW flux records into inter-zone groundwater water budgets.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Not MODFLOW execution, hydraulic interpolation or polygon zonal statistics; conserves signed intercell and source/sink fluxes across model zones.
operations.numeric_oracle: Synthetic two-cell budget: WELLS [+3,-3] m3/s and right-face flux [3,0]. Zone1 FROM_WELLS=3, TO_ZONE_2=3; Zone2 FROM_ZONE_1=3, TO_WELLS=3; both residuals 0.

operations.scientific_task: Convert fully saturated model face volumetric fluxes to Darcy specific discharge on each staggered face.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Hydraulic-gradient/flow solvers do not convert existing cell-budget face fluxes using saturated cross-sectional geometry; this is postprocessing, not generic vector decomposition.
operations.numeric_oracle: dx=2 m, thickness=5 m: side areas 10 m2 and horizontal area 4 m2; Qeast=20,Qnorth=30,Qup=16 m3/s yield q=(2,3,4) m/s on all faces.

operations.scientific_task: Calculate layer-specific saturated transmissivity intersecting screened well intervals.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Not scalar transmissivity multiplication alone: intersects multilayer geology, well screen and saturation heads at explicit model cells.
operations.numeric_oracle: Two 5 m saturated screened layers, K=[.01,.002] m/s: transmissivities [.05,.01] m2/s and total .06 m2/s; shortened 3 m first-layer interval gives .03 m2/s.

operations.scientific_task: Geolocate image pixel centres using a rational polynomial camera and explicit ellipsoidal heights.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Raster reprojection assumes existing spatial georeferencing; RPC inversion resolves camera geometry and height-dependent pixel-to-ground positions.
operations.numeric_oracle: Synthetic linear RPC line=P,sample=L with all offsets zero and scales one: pixel centre row=col=0 at ellipsoid height 0 gives lon=lat=0. Off-centre sample explicitly checks GDAL pixel-centre convention.

operations.scientific_task: Fit a thin-plate-spline ground-control transformation and locate in-hull image coordinates.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Affine geotransform/raster reprojection cannot infer a non-affine georeferencing surface from irregular GCPs; fixed TPS, not another coordinate component tool.
operations.numeric_oracle: Affine-compatible controls x=100+2*col,y=200-3*row are reproduced exactly by TPS; row=col=5 -> (110,185) m.

operations.scientific_task: Measure local spatial variation in residual dispersion with LOSH, without permutation inference.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Local Moran/Getis-Ord measure value clustering; LOSH measures spatial heterogeneity of residual variance, not another autocorrelation alias.
operations.numeric_oracle: Binary-weight four-node chain with y=[0,0,0,2]: local means [0,0,1,0], squared residuals [0,0,1,4], global mean 1.25; Hi=[0,.4,1.6,.8].

operations.scientific_task: Partition an explicit connected spatial adjacency graph into attribute-homogeneous contiguous regions with SKATER.
operations.distinct_from_existing: DBSCAN/site proximity need not yield a chosen number of adjacency-contiguous regions; this optimizes a spanning-tree regionalization heuristic with region-size constraints.
operations.numeric_oracle: Four-node chain features [0,1,10,11], two regions of at least two: only feasible connected split [0,0,1,1], within-region absolute deviations total 2.

operations.scientific_task: Count joint spatial-temporal event proximity and its contingency expectation using Knox.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Pure spatial Moran/K/Ripley and temporal anomaly tools do not test joint event-pair space-time proximity; here only observed counts and expectations, not stochastic inference.
operations.numeric_oracle: Three events at x=[0,1,10] and t=[0,1,10], thresholds 2: one of three unordered pairs is jointly close; independent-margin expected joint count=1/3.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate uncorrected Ripley K for point events using their observed bounding rectangle.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Nearest-neighbor distance is a first-neighbor summary; K counts all event pairs across multiple distances. Not an arbitrary-survey-window or edge-corrected estimator.
operations.numeric_oracle: Four unit-square corners, area=1,n=4: unordered pairs within [.5,1.1,1.5] are [0,4,6]; K=2*A*pairs/n^2=[0,.5,.75] m2.

operations.scientific_task: Evaluate attribute separation across neighboring region boundaries, not across every global cluster.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Generic silhouette ignores spatial contact; boundary silhouette evaluates only adjoining regions and explicitly distinguishes interior nodes.
operations.numeric_oracle: Four-node chain with features [0,0,10,10], labels [0,0,1,1]: two boundary nodes have zero within and positive cross distance -> 1; two interior nodes -> upstream convention 0.

operations.scientific_task: Extract polygons and diagnose cut edges, dangles and invalid rings from noded linework.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Generic polygon union/geometry repair is not a full graph polygonization diagnostic; four explicit topology categories are returned without repair.
operations.numeric_oracle: Four unit-square edges plus one spur: exactly one polygon of area 1 m2 and one dangle; no cut edges or invalid rings.

operations.scientific_task: Measure ordered centreline deviation using the discrete Frechet distance.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Hausdorff/nearest geometry proximity ignores traversal order; discrete Frechet respects ordered channel correspondence.
operations.numeric_oracle: Parallel 10 m lines separated by 2 m have discrete Frechet=2 m; reversing the second line gives sqrt(104) m, establishing traversal-order sensitivity.

operations.scientific_task: Estimate Gaussian event probability density at survey query coordinates.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Raster proximity/nearest site locates distances; Gaussian KDE estimates a normalized probability surface from all event contributions, not kriging.
operations.numeric_oracle: One event, bandwidth 2 m: origin density 1/(8*pi) m^-2; at x=2 density exp(-1/2)/(8*pi).

operations.scientific_task: Find density-connected site clusters and explicit noise with DBSCAN.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Nearest-site queries do not determine density reachability or noise; SKATER uses supplied adjacency and fixed region count rather than density-core connectivity.
operations.numeric_oracle: Sites x=[0,.5,10], epsilon=1,min_samples=2 -> labels [0,0,-1], one noise site; graph connectivity independently identifies cluster.

operations.scientific_task: Advance a gridded hillslope by one linear soil-creep diffusion step.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Terrain slope/curvature are diagnostics; this advances a PDE governing hillslope mass redistribution, not a derivative alias.
operations.numeric_oracle: Synthetic z=x^2+y^2 on 1 m grid: central 2D Laplacian=4; K=.1 m2/s,dt=.1 s -> centre elevation increase .04 m. Fixed guard nodes unchanged.

operations.scientific_task: Advance detachment-limited stream-power incision with implicit Fastscape on fixed D8 drainage.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Existing flow direction/accumulation produce routing only; fixed routing is a prerequisite here for a physically dimensioned fluvial-incision time step.
operations.numeric_oracle: Synthetic one-core-node 3x3 DEM: centre z=1, west fixed outlet z=0, all other neighbors z=2, dx=1,A=1,K=.1,dt=1 -> implicit z_new=1/(1+.1)=10/11 m. Guard nodes unchanged.

operations.scientific_task: Integrate the channel chi coordinate using true D8 link lengths and a fixed reference concavity.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Drainage distance is unweighted path length; chi integrates (A0/A)^.5 and normalizes longitudinal profiles by drainage area.
operations.numeric_oracle: Independent path integral: when all contributing path nodes have A=A0, chi increments equal physical path lengths; a two-link 1 m path is chi=2 m. Also chi scales as sqrt(A0) with fixed area/routing. Masks must exclude nonchannels rather than report them as valid zero.

operations.scientific_task: Advance shallow unconfined groundwater storage with the Dupuit-percolator approximation.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Darcy postprocessing and well transmissivity are static analyses; this evolves distributed unconfined storage with recharge and nonlinear saturated thickness.
operations.numeric_oracle: Flat closed aquifer with uniform 2 m head, base 0, land 10 and no recharge remains head=2 m and thickness=2 m exactly; no lateral gradient gives zero transport.

operations.scientific_task: Advance shallow surface water with the de Almeida local-inertial overland-flow solver.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Least-cost/drainage routing follows topography without momentum or storage; this solves dynamic shallow-water flux/depth for one bounded physical step.
operations.numeric_oracle: Flat closed wet grid h=.1 m, rainfall 1e-5 m/s, dt=.1 s: every core depth=.100001 m and every link q=0. Boundary guard values retained. Initial h_init=0 prevents hidden added water.

operations.scientific_task: Advance spatial biogenic carbonate accretion under light attenuation in a fully submerged environment.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Biogenic sediment production is neither equilibrium mineral chemistry nor mechanical sediment erosion; this is a spatial depositional-evolution law.
operations.numeric_oracle: Uniform 10 m water depth: rate=.01*tanh(5*exp(-1)) m/year; dt=1 gives that thickness at each core. Surface light=0 gives exactly zero accretion. Outer nodes unchanged.

operations.scientific_task: Compute soil-thickness-shielded bedrock-to-regolith production rates.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Terrain metrics and empirical chemical weathering indices do not calculate a thickness-dependent regolith-production field used by landscape models.
operations.numeric_oracle: At H=0, H=Hstar and H=2Hstar, rates W0, W0/e and W0/e^2; e.g. W0=.01 m/year, Hstar=1 m gives .0036787944117 at H=1.

operations.scientific_task: Calculate two-dimensional elastic lithospheric flexure from a gridded pressure increment.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Gravity forward modeling calculates acceleration from density; elastic flexure calculates mechanical plate displacement from applied load, not a gravity alias or slope-stability solver.
operations.numeric_oracle: Zero load produces exactly zero deflection. For a single point-cell force F=p*dx^2: centre w(0)=F/(8*rho*g*alpha^2), alpha=(D/(rho*g))^(1/4), D=E*Te^3/[12*(1-.25^2)]; verify alpha definition against pinned component and isotropic symmetry.

operations.scientific_task: Advect a passive soil property with depth-dependent hillslope sediment diffusion and prescribed bedrock production.
operations.distinct_from_existing: Not a geochemical mixing/speciation wrapper: follows passive material concentration under spatially coupled hillslope flux and soil production.
operations.numeric_oracle: Flat terrain gives zero sediment flux. H=1,C=2,Cbed=3,R=.01 m/year,dt=.1 year: Hnew=1.001,Cnew=2.003/1.001; nine 1 m2 core cells mass increases by .027 kg. Nonflat closed domain must conserve tracer except prescribed source.
